name: Fontsource
category: A13. Reference data and asset sources
role: Open-source (OFL) font families as version-pinned npm packages with CSS and per-subset WOFF2
summary: Fontsource publishes Google Fonts and other open families as npm packages such as @fontsource/inter, each with CSS @font-face rules and per-subset WOFF2/WOFF files. A pnpm lockfile entry pins the exact font bytes a browser capture loads, which removes system-font-fallback drift. It supplies fonts; it does not shape, subset or render them.
use_when: Pinning the exact font bytes of a browser-captured scene through the lockfile, over system fonts
A Node or browser scene needs an open font family with no download step at render time
Reading a family's WOFF2 files from node_modules for satori, opentype-js or harfbuzz input
avoid_when: Trimming a font to the glyphs used or instancing a variable font: fonttools
A brand or paid typeface the person supplies themselves: load the file directly
Reading or shaping glyphs: opentype-js or harfbuzz
license: MIT (tooling); each font keeps its own licence, @fontsource/inter is OFL-1.1
notes: 2026-11-27: Triage: assess. Package versions follow Fontsource's scheme, not the foundry's; record both when a font matters. Licence is per family, check each package. Not every Google Fonts family is mirrored the same day.
2026-11-27: Not yet checked: variable packages (@fontsource-variable/*), non-latin subsets, satori or resvg consuming the files.

assessment.rationale: Repository MIT, pushed 2026-11-09, not archived; @fontsource/inter 5.3.0 (OFL-1.1) published 2026-07-19. Fills the gap where scene fonts come from; fonttools, opentype-js and harfbuzz all assume a font file already exists.

evidence.result: @fontsource/inter 5.3.0 (OFL-1.1) in Chromium 156.0.8078.4: latin 400 and 700 woff2 SHA-256 diffed (8909904a…, 6f56409f…); 2 of 14 declared faces loaded after document.fonts.ready, only those 2 woff2 requested; two renders byte-identical PNG, differs from a no-CSS control (heading 744 vs 736 px); both PNGs inspected.
evidence.scope: One family (Inter latin 400/700), CSS route, Chromium 156 on macOS arm64; not variable packages, other subsets, satori or resvg use, or other browsers.
